svg.title: Pyramid + warp 擴大可處理位移；conditioning 與 residual 決定這個局部解能不能留下
svg.desc: 粗到細 pyramid 的 estimate warp refine，搭配角點良好 conditioning 和 flat/repeated patch ill-conditioning 的對照，說明 valid local vector 需要證據。

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pyramid + warp 擴大可處理位移；conditioning 與 residual 決定這個局部解能不能留下

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 從粗到細先把大位移縮小，再以已估位移 warp；但金字塔不會替平坦紋理、掉幀或錯誤對應製造可觀察證據。

svg.text: condition number · residual · forward–backward / outlier policy

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: corner → retain evidence flat / repeated → reject

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Large displacement, long frame gap or a dropped frame can violate local linearisation: a pyramid may still converge to the wrong place.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Declare levels / scale / termination, retain residual and reject evidence, then HOLD when the pair is outside validated coverage.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Microsoft JhengHei, Noto Sans TC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pyramid 是版本化的位移處理策略；它不能把無紋理、遮擋或失真的 frame pair 自動變成可信 local flow。
